interface Animal {
  name: string;
}
interface Dog extends Animal {
  bark(): void;
}
function combine<T>(a: (x: T) => void, b: (x: T) => void) {
  return (x: T) => {
    a(x);
    b(x);
  };
}
const f = combine(
  (x: Animal) => {},
  (x: Dog) => {}
);
f({ name: "a" });
const unrelated = combine(
  (x: { a: number }) => {},
  (x: { b: string }) => {}
);
type Arg<T> = T extends { a: (x: infer U) => void; b: (x: infer U) => void } ? U : never;
const arg: Arg<{ a: (x: Animal) => void; b: (x: Dog) => void }> = { name: "d" };
